cohort: existing independent confirmation set, 8x8 and five colors, 200 certified boards, 50 each from g6-m3, g10-m4, g8-m2, g10-m3

sample_plan.pilot: first eight certified boards per recipe in the original seed order, reusable as part of the full dataset
sample_plan.stochastic_alignment: counter-based per board, agent, episode, turn and draw, with common policy-action randomness where states coincide

natural_distribution: Every refill wave uses the published fixed integer color quotas, with uniformly shuffled arrangements. Refill size cap 12 and cascade search depth 9, and only stabilized proven continuations are used.

Witness.policy: play the original verified certificate edge

Conditional.policy: accept the first independently verified safe proposal from up to six draws; use a verified witness when all are rejected or unresolved

MinIntervention.policy: keep one natural proposal exactly when independently verified safe; otherwise use a verified witness

interpretation: Verified support is a conservative subset of the full mathematical safe set. Finite Conditional is a mixture of the natural law conditioned on verified support and the witness fallback. Single-draw reuse is a minimum-TV construction on verified support, not a unique or exact optimizer over unresolved transitions.
primary: For V1/V3/V4 frozen Witness-era definitions and cuts, compare each controller's board scores and tiers against the original exact Witness using paired board IDs. Use within-recipe Spearman and count tier shifts. Witness replay MC against exact Witness calibrates sampling noise.
cross_agent: Report macro and per-recipe correlations for Greedy/Objective/Lookahead with spare move and Q+3 endpoints, and same-model tier results. Do not tune candidates from these results.
eligibility: Reject any result with a failed Strict certificate replay or basic goal misses. Report attempted, certified-safe, infeasible, and unresolved proposals separately from witness fallbacks. These axes apply to this simulated fixed rule set.
